release.intakePath: Service-role-only decision_manifest_batch_intake RPC; Bolt, Lovable and v0 have reviewed direct excerpts and claim-level exclusion for unsupported legacy assertions. Replit remains HOLD_EVIDENCE because Starter availability is not sufficiently bounded. Migration remains unapplied and no production write has occurred.
release.publicationPath: Existing decision_cluster_transition RPC with exact reviewed Task Capability, Tool Capability and Fit version lists; independent QA reference mandatory
release.singleToolHoldPolicy: Exclude a HOLD tool and its evidence/relations from the exact publication manifest; do not alter other tool decisions
release.preflight: Directory row FOR SHARE with exact identity/version; service-role RPC checks complete canonical SHA-256 payload, reviewer and QA reference, exact Task Capability review fields and target zero rows. Default execution rolls back the whole subtransaction.
release.rollback: Batch record stores exact source/claim/timeline/relation/link IDs and full postimage. Revert locks targets, requires exact postimage and reviewed status, deletes only recorded IDs with row-count checks, and rejects additions or drift. Default revert-preflight rolls back.
release.idempotentPostcheck: Complete payload hash is recomputed by RPC. A same-batch replay requires every recorded row image unchanged and unexpired; any additional Source/Claim/link/timeline, content drift or status change fails closed. This has only been exercised against synthetic local PostgreSQL fixtures, not production.
